test.fill_query: INSERT INTO FUNCTION file('test_parquet_top_k_row_group_order.parquet', Parquet) SELECT (number % 100000) + 100000 * ((intDiv(number, 100000) * 37 + 11) % 200) AS k, sipHash64(number) AS v, number % 1000 AS m, toString(number) AS s FROM numbers(20000000) SETTINGS output_format_parquet_row_group_size = 100000, max_block_size = 100000, max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1, engine_file_truncate_on_insert = 1
